emails.subject: Healthy Snack Options for the Coffee Shop
emails.body:
Hi Dad,

It was great chatting today at the coffee shop! As promised, I've attached some healthy snack options that I think could be a big hit with your customers. These recipes focus on nutrition without sacrificing flavor.

Check them out when you have a moment and let me know what you think. I'm excited to help bring a healthier twist to the shop's offerings!

Best,
Lucas
